function.name: Bash
function.description: Execute a CLI command. Supports: adb shell (device control), sql (device database), http (backend services)

steps.message: Find Kevin's resume and send a text message to Kevin saying:
Insert sent SMS to 15551234567 into telephony database

arguments.command: sql /data/user/0/com.android.providers.telephony/databases/mmssms.db "INSERT INTO sms (address,body,type,date,read,seen) VALUES ('15551234567','Your interview is scheduled for tomorrow morning at 10:30 AM.',2,$(date +%s)000,1,1)"
